name: Don´t Burst My Balloon
detailed_description:
Ornithes, a planet dominated by intelligent and magical birds, stands out for the chickens on the continent of Farm, where skilled warriors, many with elemental skills, live in isolated rival tribes. Although his intelligence is a blessing, it has also brought conflict. To settle disputes and decide which tribe is the most powerful, the Dominus Aviarium (Lord of the Birds) was created, a brutal competition that tests strength, strategy and magic. In these challenges, only the most cunning and strongest chicken can win the ultimate glory.

It's a local multiplayer action, fighting and strategy game, where players take control of chickens in intense 1v1 duels and up to 4v4 players simultaneously, either all against all or as a team.

In vibrant arenas and challenging, the chickens use their balloons, agile movements and unique skills to take on their opponents and pop the balloons that sustain them. Tactics are essential, as players must balance offense with defense, avoiding their opponent's attacks while trying to hit their balloons. Mysterious strategic items and dynamic obstacles add extra layers of depth to the game, requiring quick thinking and precision.

Main features:

  • Local multiplayer for up to 4 players;

  • Characters inspired by real bird species;

  • Easy-to-learn controls;

  • Perfect for parties with friends and family;

  • Original soundtrack.

    Gather all your friends and find out who is the most powerful chicken of all.
